designation: IN THE HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND AT RANCHI
jurisdictionNote: High Court for the State of Jharkhand, established in 2000 upon bifurcation from Bihar. Has original, appellate, and writ jurisdiction. Handles anticipatory bail under S.482 BNSS, criminal appeals, writ petitions, and mining/forest-related disputes.

localRules: All petitions must be filed through an advocate enrolled with the Bar Council of Jharkhand.
Anticipatory bail applications must be accompanied by a duly sworn affidavit.
Certified copy of FIR and remand order must be annexed.
Index of documents is mandatory with page numbering.
Vakalatnama to be filed at the first instance.
